question: A sum of Rs. 9200 was lent partly at 5% p.a. and the rest at 8% p.a., both earning simple interest. Total interest received after 3 years was Rs. 1812. The sum (in Rs.) lent at 5% p.a. was
solution:
**Given:**

Principle (P) = Rs. 9200 

Rate of interest (R₁) = 5% per annum 

Rate of interest (R₂) = 8% per annum 

Time period (T) = 3 years 

Total interest received = Rs. 1812

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Let the sum lent at a 5% rate be 'x', then the sum lent at 8% be (9200 - x)

⇒ SI = (SI at 5%) + (SI at 8%)

⇒ 1812 = [(x × 5 × 3)/100] + {[(9200 - x) × 8 × 3 ]/100}

⇒ 1812 = [15x/100] + {[220800 - 24x]/100}

⇒ 1812 = 15x + 220800 - 24x

⇒ 181200 = 220800 - 9x

⇒ x = (220800 - 181200)/9

⇒ x = 39600/9 = Rs. 4400

**∴ The sum (in Rs.) lent at 5% p.a. was Rs. 4400.**
